Picklebet is a top 10 Australian racing, sports, and esports betting platform built for the next generation of players. We’re fast, innovative, and expanding internationally. This is your chance to be a member of our brand-new UK support team .

Best of all, we believe in true work-life balance. As a Customer Support Operator, you’ll be the voice of Picklebet , delivering high-quality, empathetic, and real-time support via live chat and email.

You will have:

Champion our customers: Own live chat and email conversations, solving everything from complex betting queries to technical glitches with speed and personality.

•
Deliver industry-leading support: Build strong relationships with our customers while thriving in a fast-paced, real-time environment where priorities can shift quickly.

•
Keep gaming safe: Support our Responsible Gambling commitments by identifying potential signs of customer harm, following safer gambling procedures, and helping maintain a safe and fair experience for all customers.

•
Bridge the gap to tech: Investigate customer feedback, escalate bugs and improvement opportunities, and collaborate cross-functionally with teams to improve the platform experience.

•
Grow with us: This is a genuine entry-level role into the gaming space with opportunities to progress as our UK operations scale.

Essential:

• Previous experience in a customer-facing or customer service role

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Strong problem-solving skills

• High level of attention to detail

• Ability to stay calm, empathetic & professional when handling customer concerns

• Confidence working independently in a remote environment

• Reliable home working setup and stable internet connection

• Availability to work evenings and weekends

• Betting industry experience and/or a genuine passion for Sport & Racing

• 2+ years of experience in betting, gaming, fintech, or other fast-moving digital environments

• Experience using tools like Zendesk, Jira, or Confluence

• A passion for racing and sport

You’ll be joining a top 10 Australian betting brand making serious waves internationally, with a genuine opportunity to help scale our new UK team from the ground up.

You’ll work on an innovative product across racing, sports and esports, gaining hands-on experience in a fast-moving, highly regulated digital industry where ideas turn into action quickly. As we continue to grow, so will your opportunities.

What really sets us apart is our team culture - collaborative, accountable, and full of people who take ownership, support each other, and genuinely care about doing great work.

The partner’s day. Complex, multi-time-zone diaries: schedule, protect, and make the call when two things collide. •
How you work. Anything belonging to the wider function goes through the Legal Operations intake channel rather than into your own list. You work to the team’s published response standards. You reach for AI first and tell us when you have found a faster way.

• 5+ years supporting partners, senior fee earners or C-suite executives, ideally in law or professional services.

• Ability to remain poised under pressure, multitask, and prioritize effectively

• Strong team orientation and a preference for collaboration

• Experience with a practice management, billing, time-capture or document management system - or evidence you have learned a comparable system quickly

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Observe by Snowflake
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is an AI-powered observability platform built natively on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. Its Telemetry Lakehouse Foundation enables organizations to ingest, retain, and analyze massive volumes of telemetry more economically than traditional observability platforms while keeping data reusable across analytics and AI through open table formats such as Apache Iceberg. Its Observability Context Graph captures relationships across services, infrastructure, logs, metrics, and traces, providing the semantic context needed to reason about complex systems. A programmable AI SRE automates investigation workflows to reduce manual effort and accelerate incident resolution.

Trusted by engineering teams at organizations including Capital One, HPE, and Breeze Airways, Observe ingests and analyzes hundreds of terabytes of telemetry daily while maintaining enterprise-scale reliability. Observe joined Snowflake through its acquisition in February 2026.

The Infrastructure team at Observe by Snowflake is responsible for architecting, scaling, and operating the development and production environments that power our observability platform. We are a small, highly collaborative team with broad scope and high ownership, focused on delivering reliable, secure, and scalable infrastructure while continuously evolving the systems that support our engineers and customers.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping our infrastructure strategy, driving architectural decisions, and elevating operational excellence across the organization. Examples of the work you'd take on include launching single-tenant and multi-tenant environments for new customers on tight timelines, migrating our Kubernetes ingress from Ingress-NGINX to Envoy and the Gateway API, shifting our release process from script-driven lockstep weekly deploys to GitOps with ArgoCD, and building repeatable processes for infrastructure upgrades, refreshes, and migrations across the fleet.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Lead the design, build, and operation of scalable, secure AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure across shared and dedicated customer environments, supporting a high-scale observability platform.

- Help integrate Observe's infrastructure into Snowflake's platforms, including CI, source control, and container platform migrations, bridging startup-era systems with enterprise-grade standards.

- Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling, and platform automation, moving our delivery pipeline toward GitOps and independent, safe service deployments.

- Partner with the Security team to improve access controls, secrets management, and the security posture of production environments, enabling other teams (including AI and automation initiatives) to move fast without compromising security or maintainability.

- Design and implement infrastructure patterns that ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and operational resilience.

- Participate in the infrastructure on-call rotation and play a key role in incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident improvements that drive systemic reliability enhancements.

- Partner cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams to ensure infrastructure strategy supports long-term platform evolution.

title: Loan Servicing Specialist (Private Real Estate Lending)
description:
PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH
Location: Remote, Latin America (LATAM)
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Openings: 1
Industry: Real Estate Finance / Private Lending
Compensation: $1,300 to $1,800 USD/month
Experience: 1.5+ years at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender
Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)
English Proficiency: Advanced written and spoken English required
Start Date: As soon as possible (early November 2026)
About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based private real estate lender that provides short-term, business-purpose loans to real estate investors.
The company finances Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR rental and Ground-Up Construction projects and works with a third-party loan servicer, note buyers and capital partners to manage its loan portfolio.
As its portfolio grows, the company is building out its remote operations team to keep every funded loan accurately tracked and every borrower well supported.
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Loan Servicing Specialist to own the post-closing servicing workflow and borrower and partner follow-through.
You will board funded loans with the third-party servicer, manage construction draws, monitor maturities, payments and delinquencies, and answer borrower and partner questions until each one is resolved.
The third-party servicer prepares servicing calculations; this specialist reviews and coordinates them. Speed, accuracy, ownership and exceptional borrower service are central to the role.
What You'll Do
Loan Boarding & Records

• Board funded loans with the third-party servicer.

• Validate terms, balances, reserves and maturity dates.

• Maintain accurate records in the company's loan portal and servicing systems.

Construction Draws

• Manage construction draw requests end to end: budget and reserve checks, inspections, documentation, review and approvals within delegated limits.

• Coordinate disbursements and give borrowers proactive updates.

Maturities, Extensions & Payoffs

• Monitor upcoming maturities and coordinate extensions.

• Coordinate payoffs and extensions with the servicer, reviewing its calculations, statements and documents for accuracy.

• Track completion and lien releases.

Portfolio Monitoring

• Identify inactive or stalled loans with no recent progress, updates or borrower communication.

• Contact the relevant parties, document status and escalate risks.

• Monitor missed payments and delinquencies, follow up with borrowers and the servicer, and escalate potential defaults or unresolved issues.

Borrower & Partner Support

• Answer borrower, note buyer and warehouse lender questions about loans, draws, balances, payments, extensions and payoffs.

• Own each inquiry until it is resolved.

Qualifications
Required

• At least 1.5 years of hands-on experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender, originating or servicing business-purpose investment property loans (Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and/or Ground-Up Construction).

• Direct experience servicing short-term hard money or business-purpose loans.

• Experience with construction draw management, payoffs and extensions.

• Advanced written and spoken English.

• High attention to detail.

• Ability to work in Gmail, GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM, and an online loan portal for documents, files and workflow.

• Hardworking, dependable, proactive and accountable. You take ownership and follow up without reminders.

• Comfortable in a fast-paced lending business, handling urgent requests and meeting deadlines without compromising accuracy or controls.

• Availability to work 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Preferred

• Experience working with a third-party loan servicer.
Please note: conventional consumer mortgage experience alone (FHA, VA, Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac loans) does not meet the experience requirement.
How Success Is Measured

• Funded loans are boarded quickly and accurately.

title: Senior Project Manager

Who We Are: Front Office Transformation Experts
Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.
What We Do: Cutting Complexity Across the Front Office
We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.
The Role
You'll run a portfolio of enterprise client projects across the Adobe and Salesforce ecosystems, taking each one from pitch to plan to delivery. On any given week you'll have several projects live at once, from platform upgrades to full implementations, each with its own technical team and its own client executives. You sit at the center of it: the person our consultants, partner vendors and client leadership all look to for a straight answer on status, risk and what happens next. You also own the numbers, keeping every project on budget and on margin. Clients judge BPX on whether projects land on time and on budget, which makes this role central to how they see us. Internally, this position maps to our Project Manager role within our global structure.
What you'll do

• Lead concurrent projects across Adobe and Salesforce, from platform upgrades to full enterprise implementations.

• Direct technical teams of consultants and platform specialists deploying front-office solutions inside complex client environments.

• Keep clients confident through clear status reporting and honest risk conversations with executive stakeholders.

• Hold every project to margin, managing budget, resourcing and revenue reporting against target.

• Report the financials accurately for implementation projects and retained services engagements alike.

• Run delivery in Kantata and Jira, tracking project health and resource allocation, with AI flagging risks earlier.

• Pick the right method for each engagement, waterfall or agile, and adjust when the project changes shape.

• You'll work with clients and colleagues across multiple regions, so some flexibility with your working hours to accommodate different time zones will be needed from time to time.

What you'll bring

• Enterprise delivery experience: 8+ years managing technology implementations for enterprise clients, ideally in a consultancy.

• Adobe or Salesforce depth, having delivered Adobe Experience Cloud or Salesforce projects and understood the technical detail.

• Multi-project control, with a track record of running several client projects at once without losing the thread.

• Commercial ownership of project budgets, margin, change requests and statements of work.

• Executive presence to lead status meetings and hard conversations about risk with senior client stakeholders.

• Waterfall and agile fluency; PMP, PRINCE2 or Scrum certification is a plus.

• Delivery tooling know-how in PSA and work-tracking platforms such as Kantata and Jira.
Why this role, why now
BPX is growing on private equity backing, and each new Adobe and Salesforce client adds projects that need someone to run them well. You'll step into a varied enterprise portfolio with direct access to client executives
